english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when a person or thing is prepared and can be used or acted on immediately.
Use this for food or another thing that has been prepared and is ready to use.

examples.english: I'm ready, so we can set off.
examples.traditional: 我準備好喇，可以出發喇。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zeon2 bei6 hou2 laa3 ho2 ji5 ceot1 faat3 laa3

examples.english: The salad is dressed and ready to eat.
examples.traditional: 沙律已經準備好，可以食喇。
examples.jyutping: saa1 leot6 ji5 ging1 zeon2 bei6 hou2 ho2 ji5 sik6 laa3
